pages.title: Poopmaker's Goods
pages.text: Buy Dragon Breath Chili from a Poopmaker villager.$(br2)Eating it gives Intestinal Spasm and sets you on fire briefly.

pages.title: Lava from the Toilet
pages.text: While affected by Intestinal Spasm, sneak on a non-wood toilet to turn it into a lava toilet.$(br2)Use a bucket on it to collect lava.
